Position Summary

We are excited to announce a Sales Representative opportunity within Vantage’s Food business unit, a pivotal role on our high‑performing sales team. We are seeking a driven, strategic, and customer‑focused professional with strong sales or commercial experience who can make an immediate impact on our business and deliver exceptional value to our customers.

This role is remote, with a preference for candidates located near a major airport due to the extensive travel required. The ideal candidate will bring demonstrated commercial excellence, a track record of value creation, and the agility to thrive in a dynamic, customer‑centric environment.

Position Scope

This role is accountable for achieving sales and gross margin targets across assigned accounts. You will play a key part in shaping account strategies and contributing to broader business objectives and financial performance. This is a highly rewarding opportunity with strong growth potential and a clear, visible impact on both internal stakeholders and external business partners. The position requires a commitment to extended hours when needed, the ability to perform effectively under pressure, and the capacity to excel in a fast‑paced environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Key duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Manage the full sales cycle, including prospecting, lead generation, opportunity development, and closing to achieve targeted outcomes.

  • Serve as the Voice of the Customer by understanding customer priorities, building trusted relationships, and proactively driving issue resolution.

  • Analyze market data to deliver actionable insights that support business objectives and strategic decision‑making.

  • Engage actively in the Vantage Commercial Excellence Program by developing account strategies, preparing pre‑call plans, completing post‑call reports, and effectively managing the opportunity pipeline using CRM tools.

Education & Experience

Knowledge, Skills, & Talents

  • Ability to research, understand, and develop both current and prospective customers, with a focus on opportunity identification and long‑term relationship building.

  • Consistent, timely, and proactive communication with customers and internal stakeholders to ensure alignment and optimal service delivery.

  • Exceptional planning, interpersonal, organizational, and time‑management skills, with the ability to balance multiple priorities effectively.

  • Willingness and ability to travel 25–50% or more, including frequent overnight stays, based on business needs.

  • High level of computer proficiency, including diligent use of commonly utilized software to support sales, marketing, and business activities (e.g., Microsoft Office Suite, CRM platforms) and strong internet research capabilities.

  • Aptitude for applying logical or scientific reasoning to a wide range of intellectual and practical challenges, with the ability to navigate both abstract and concrete variables.

Pay

raw.excerpt: At DICK’S Sporting Goods, we believe in how positively sports can change lives.
raw.description:
At DICK’S Sporting Goods, we believe in how positively sports can change lives. On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.

If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world’s greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

OVERVIEW:

Welcome to Product Management at DICK’S Sporting Goods, where we specialize in delivering retail excellence along every aspect of the customer journey.

Our mission focuses on crafting intuitive, easy-to-use products that span across our business. We are looking for a new team member who can bring product-market viability ideas that inspire, innovate and deliver elevated experiences for our customers and products.

Like an Athlete, our technology teams focus on speed, flexibility, durability, and resilience so that we are always ready for the next ‘play.’ In Store Technology, we obsess over delivering tools and services that empower our teammates to create a seamless checkout experience for every Athlete who shops with us. Our Store Checkout team is dedicated to ensuring the final moment of the shopping journey is as smooth and delightful as the first. Come join a team where our mission is to make every store checkout experience a win!

This role will own a comprehensive portfolio responsible for delivering a seamless, end‑to‑end in‑store checkout experience, spanning fixed lanes, flexible/mobile checkout, and core point‑of‑sale platforms. You will define and maintain clear functional and non‑functional product artifacts that enable fast, intuitive, and reliable checkout journeys for both customers and store associates. The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in lean product management, a metrics‑driven approach to decision‑making, and a deeply user‑centered mindset, with experience in complex, high‑throughput retail environments. Your leadership will help orchestrate an integrated checkout ecosystem that reduces friction, improves operational efficiency, and proactively resolves issues before they impact the transaction.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will work closely with other product managers, product designers, software engineers and stakeholders to deliver innovative products and services that align to strategic priorities as well as achieve product-market fit. You will be viewed as a leader within the organization and deliver of high-quality products through the following:

Product Vision & Strategy
The very essence of being a product manager is having a solid foundation to build upon. In this role, you will blend innovation, strategy and execution to deliver top-notch experiences to customers. You will define and establish a comprehensive vision, strategy and roadmap for your product within a modern development environment.

Product Outcomes

Be the “voice of the product” empathizing with customers and stakeholders! As a Senior Product Manager, you will set goals based on outcomes and measure progress towards those goals as well as alignment back to the business. That data then informs future product iterations and prioritization within your roadmap.

Stakeholder Enablement
Bringing cohesion and coordination to domain level initiatives by blending strategy and tactics to achieve business results is essential in this role. You will interact with all functional areas of the company including product design, software engineering, leadership and portfolio stakeholder groups.

Product-Market Fit & Go-to-Market Strategies
You will develop compelling arguments for your product success in the market as well as launch strategies that are inclusive of ramp up, marketing and adoption strategies.

Delivery
Part of the job is to manage the backlog. You will create effective user stories as well as lead backlog prioritization and management; performing testing of product features with engineers to ensure acceptance criteria is met, capture bugs and work towards defect resolution.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

Leadership – How you expand your influence through strategy, decision making, coaching, and management

Enlist & Enable Stakeholders

  • Uses evidence-based influencing skills

  • Manages complex stakeholder relationships

  • Conducts stakeholder identification workshops and creates stakeholder map by product

  • Creates and communicates standard stakeholder touchpoints to maintain alignment

  • Conducts stakeholder input sessions across various levels within the organization

  • Leads Framing exercises and facilitates the enablement of stakeholders

Leadership & People Management

  • Acts as a trusted expert, teammate and operations leader within your product domain

  • Uses organizational agility to influence teammates and peers without formal authority

  • Effectively mobilizes a team(s) and leads through uncertainty

  • Acts as an agent of change within the organization

  • Creates a people-first culture where teammates thrive

  • Advocates for the Lean Product mindset and leads by example

  • Actively participates within the Product Community of Practice inclusive of coaching and mentoring responsibilities

Strategy – How you understand and plan within a product team that solves customer problems and drives market impact

Form Strategy & Prioritize Work

  • Builds the roadmap, collaboratively with stakeholders, based on outcomes

  • Uses decision support tools to weigh the competing factors and objectives for a product(s)

  • Effectively explains ‘why’ you prioritized the work

  • Leads the creation of the vision and strategy for the product(s) that you support within a team setting

  • Communicates product strategy with dependent teams, stakeholders and leadership

  • Develops core positioning and messaging for product, inclusive of developing the product marketing sales tools and collateral

Identify Opportunities

  • Uses data to discover customer pain points

  • Identifies the right problems and prioritizes for the best business outcomes, aligning to the overarching portfolio strategy

  • Identifies complex patterns in data and builds expanded research models in partnership with Product Design

  • Uses advanced storytelling to capture the audience and drives alignment / decisions

  • Leads Product-Market Fit analysis, segmentation and buyer behavior for a product domain

Form & Track KPIs/Metrics

  • Develops growth matrixes, manages product team budget, sets pricing to meet revenue and profitability goals

  • Gathers data and conducts research to identify Product ROI

  • Evaluates ROI and uses to develop business cases for potential opportunities

  • Measures adoption, usage data and business impact of launches to prove ROI

  • Builds product objectives and goals in collaboration with key stakeholders

  • Drives accountability through facilitated data-driven ROI ceremonies

  • Regularly reports out on progress towards goals as well as product health

  • Identifies lagging and leading indicators to measure progress towards goals and outcomes

Execution – How you support and provide oversight to the design and delivery of solutions to our customers

As a Senior Product Manager, you may support one or more product teams within a given portfolio.

Deliver Products/Features

  • Proactively identifies dependencies and mitigates risky assumptions

  • Identifies and communicates risks associated with shipping features

  • Builds the release plan (who, what and when) including feature prioritization

  • Collaboratively builds the User Story map and corresponding user stories

  • Writes user stories to articulate work to be done by software engineering that support outcome delivery

  • Works closely with software engineering to ensure delivery of products map to customer experience and business requirements within needed timelines

  • Manages testing to detect and fix issues to make necessary improvements

  • Manages third party partnerships, assessments and identification of potential opportunities

  • Leads sprint planning or iteration planning meetings

  • Runs experimental, beta & pilot programs with early-stage products

  • Participates in Agile ceremonies, including stand ups, demos and retrospectives

  • Communicates with legal, compliance, security and other critical teams

QUALIFICATIONS:

Candidates for this Role Should Have:

  • An advanced understanding of Product Management

  • Advanced knowledge and application of human-centered design practices

  • Understanding of a product lifecycle

  • Understanding of the software development lifecycle

  • Ability to balance business objectives & customer needs

  • Success in defining a cohesive product vision, strategies and roadmap

  • Ability to speak to and application of complex product concepts

  • Advanced go-to-market strategies resulting in successful product launches

  • Customer-centric view into developing great product experiences and the ability to advocate on a customer’s behalf

  • Use of market data, customer needs and innovative thinking to remain competitive in the domain

  • Intermediate understanding of Scrum and application in a Product Management role

  • Effective facilitation, relationship building and collaboration skills to drive alignment across organizational peers and stakeholder groups

  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams and leadership stakeholders without formal authority

  • Agility to move between product domains or portfolios as business needs arise

  • Advanced written and verbal communication skills

  • Curious attitude and desire to learn

  • Ability to know when to pivot or persevere based on data and learnings

  • Experience working with third party vendors

This is a fully remote position.

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

VIRTUAL REQUIREMENTS:

At DICK’S, we thrive on innovation and authenticity. That said, to protect the integrity and security of our hiring process, we ask that candidates do not use AI tools (like ChatGPT or others) during interviews or assessments.

To ensure a smooth and secure experience, please note the following:

  • Cameras must be on during all virtual interviews.

  • AI tools are not permitted to be used by the candidateduring any part of the interview process.

  • Offers are contingent upon a satisfactory background check which may include ID verification.

If you have any questions or need accommodations, we’re here to help. Thanks for helping us keep the process fair and secure for everyone!

Targeted Pay Range: $95,200.00 - $158,800.00. This is part of a competitive total rewards package that could include other components such as: incentive, equity and benefits. Individual pay is determined by a number of factors including experience, location, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. We review all teammate pay regularly to ensure competitive and equitable pay.DICK'S Sporting Goods complies with all state paid leave requirements. We also offer a generous suite of benefits. To learn more, visit www.benefityourliferesources.com.

Contributes to the mentoring of programming personnel through developing training courses, presenting training materials, reviewing work, and providing feedback or guiding new associates in process. Transfers deliverables. Performs other work-related duties as assigned.
  • Minimal travel may be required.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Founded in 2020, Lavender is the largest nurse-owned and operated online psychiatry and therapy office in the United States. Our extraordinary team of 100+ talented and like-minded folks works remotely from across the United States, Canada and the Philippines to collaboratively increase access to high-quality, high-touch mental healthcare. Lavender is a human-first organization and our people embody:

  • A bias towards action
  • A capacity for self-direction
  • Originality and creative instincts
  • Courageous and bold thinking
  • And the potential to achieve even more

If you’re looking for a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment where your voice matters and you can truly have an impact creating high-quality, user-centric mental health services, we want to hear from you!

Lavender is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives and background will lead to a better environment for our team and a better experience for our clients. We strongly encourage people of color and members of the LGBTQ+ community to apply.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking both part-time and full-time Psychiatric Nurse Practitioners to perform tele-psychiatric visits for clients based in Oregon. If you enjoy working on a team with bright, ambitious advanced practice nurses and are seeking the flexibility and autonomy of private practice, this is an excellent opportunity for you. We offer a competitive 1099 compensation model and a supportive work environment that offers mentorship and training. You can build your own schedule within our operating hours, which are 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. seven days a week. We require a minimum commitmentof 16 hours per week

Benefits of Being a Lavender NP

  • Flexible self-scheduling
  • Paid physician collaborators
  • No patient minimums
  • ANCC accredited continuing ed
  • Fellowship program for NPs as part of onboarding
  • 3-month new grad mentorship program
  • UpToDate subscription
  • Paid EHR and e-Prescribe
  • Leadership development program
  • Teaching honorariums

What Makes Lavender Special

  • A caring, spirited, and experienced team. We are nurse-founded and led!
  • Be part of a company that is truly making a difference in the world
  • Work remotely with the full support of an expert team
  • An international work environment that embraces diversity and inclusion
  • Be part of a growing startup where you have the opportunity to help shape the company
  • Company-sponsored In-person meetups (so far we’ve gathered in New York and Mexico!)
  • Fun and engaging company culture with regular virtual team events
  • Competitive compensation
  • Annual profit sharing
  • Annual giving program - donation by Lavender to your chosen charity
  • Book clubs and other community events

The Responsibilities:

Conduct initial evaluations and collaboratively develop treatment plans with clients for medication, therapy or a combination of both. Proactively follow up with clients at minimum on a monthly basis to assess for efficacy of recommended interventions and ongoing care until treatment goals are achieved. Our clientele strongly prefer combined medication and therapy appointments, you have to be comfortable providing various modalities of talk therapy.

The Candidate:

  • Master of Science in Nursing (MSN)
  • Active Oregon Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner License
  • ANCC Board Certification
  • 2+ years of experience working in adult mental health
  • Strong assessment skills
  • Excellent communication and documentation abilities
  • Ambitious, client-centric work ethic
  • Must have own computer and a quiet, professional space to take tele-psychiatry appointments

Job Types: Full-time, Part-time, Contract

Weekly schedule:

  • Monday to Friday
  • Weekend availability

Work Setting:

  • Remote

Experience:

  • Psychiatric Nursing: 2 years (Preferred)

License/Certification:

  • Oregon Nurse Practitioner License (Required)
  • ANCC Board Certification (Required)
  • DEA Certification (Required)

Apply today so you too can be a part of an amazing team! We thank everyone that applies but please note that only qualified candidates will be contacted for an interview.

For more about what it’s like to work at Lavender, see our careers page at https://www.joinlavender.com/careers.

Join DaVita Integrated Kidney Care (IKC) as a Nurse Practitioner in New Jersey!

Are you a Nurse Practitioner ready to transform lives and make a real difference for patients with complex kidney conditions? DaVita IKC is looking for a passionate NP to join remotely our team in New Jersey, helping patients navigate a challenging healthcare system while receiving holistic, integrated care.

We’re on a mission to revolutionize kidney care, with a vision of making integrated care the standard of care for all renal patients. To help us achieve our vision, we’re investing extensively in developing both our model of care and our team. When you join DaVita IKC, you're joining a compassionate team committed to quality patient care. Through our commitment to training, growth and quality we consistently achieve superior clinical outcomes while giving teammates the opportunity to excel in an award-winning environment that enables them to thrive both professionally and personally.

Position Details:

  • REMOTE in New Jersey: work from home.This is currently a Remote position. However, we value in-person patient care and may transition to a hybrid-remote model in the future.

  • Clinical Care & Evaluation: The primary responsibility is completing Comprehensive Health Evaluations (CHEs) to assess and manage comorbid conditions while addressing medical, social, emotional, and financial needs. Reduce hospitalizations and improve patient outcomes.

  • Care Management & Disease Progression: Manage CKD patients, focusing on slowing disease progression, reducing costs, and preventing readmissions. Utilize prescriptive authority, medication management, and diagnostic interpretation in collaboration with nephrologists and interdisciplinary teams.

  • Clinical Leadership: Lead the clinical team to ensure care coordination aligns with medical treatment plans and addresses both medical and psychosocial needs.

  • Schedule & Benefits: Monday–Friday, full-time, self-managed schedule with the ability to accommodate patient and nephrology partner availability—flexibility is key. No nights, weekends, or on-call. Competitive pay, excellent benefits, CEU/CME reimbursement, paid license renewals, and more.

Requirements:

  • Passion for caring for patients with complex, chronic illnesses

  • Willingness to adapt as the program evolves

  • Minimum 2 years’ experience as a Nurse Practitioner (NP)

  • Current, unrestricted NP license in state of practice; DEA license or eligibility within 90 days

  • Current CPR/BLS certification

  • Valid driver’s license and insurance in the state

  • Intermediate computer skills (MS Word, Excel, Outlook)

  • Strong clinical judgment, autonomous decision-making, and expertise in managing complex comorbidities

  • Positive, solution-focused attitude, committed to improving patient and team outcomes

  • Home office, high-speed internet, and reliable transportation

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years’ experience as a Family NP, Primary Care NP, or in Internal Medicine, Cardiology, Nephrology, or Endocrinology.

  • Experience in Value-Based Care or Population Health, including Medicare Advantage documentation and Health Risk Assessments

  • Experience managing population health with a focus on reducing hospitalizations

  • Prior experience with Cerner or similar EHR systems

  • Evaluate digital chip design workflows to enhance AI model training and evaluation.
  • Design and verify RTL components using Verilog/SystemVerilog.
  • Collaborate with architecture, verification, and implementation teams to improve model outputs.
  • Develop reusable verification components and testbench infrastructure.
  • Leverage LLM-based tools to accelerate chip design and verification processes.

  • 3–10 years of experience in digital RTL design or design verification.

  • Knowledge of AMBA protocols (AXI, AHB, APB).
